picture:coldread.src.svg.why: The blind reader saw a picture cut out, handed to a reader with no context, its description compared with a claim, ending in pass or redraw.

section:How it works.why: The reader described the cold read by a stranger whose misses are redone, and found the picture matching.

picture:plan.src.svg.why: The blind reader saw a plan listing sections each with a word budget and a picture slot, which matches the claim.

section:What you get.why: The reader understood a README plan with per-section word budgets and pictures, and said the picture fits.

picture:ask.src.svg.why: The blind reader saw one command, a few questions with preselected suggestions, then it works on its own.

section:Use.why: The reader understood one call, a few questions with suggested answers, then it works alone.

readme.why: The reader said it reads the repo, asks a few questions and writes a README with animated pictures checked by a cold read, which matches in substance.
